item.title: Chippewa Valley holds off Dakota to forge four-way tie in MAC Red race
item.description: Chippewa Valley gained its revenge on Macomb Dakota Wednesday night. After dropping an 77-74 double-overtime game to Dakota back on Jan. 8, the Big Reds held off the Cougars down the stretch this time around in a 58-54 Macomb Area Conference Red Division victory to gain a measure of revenge.
